title: MIN ( 2, BLANK ): the sources disagree between BLANK and 0

source.supports: DAX Guide gives this expression with the result BLANK
the Microsoft page says a positive number against BLANK gives 0

derivation: DAX Guide expands MIN ( v1, v2 ) to SWITCH ( TRUE, v1 = v2, ..., v1 < v2, v1, v2 ). With v1 = 2 and v2 = BLANK: 2 = BLANK is false, 2 < BLANK is false (BLANK compares as 0), so v2, the BLANK, is returned.
alternative: Microsoft Learn says BLANK is treated as 0 and the result is 0: [r] would be 0 (int64).
notes: The column's type is not asserted: no source says what type an all-BLANK result has.
